payload.title: Deployable legal coefficient candidate
payload.statement: A surface-free E003-style datum-plus-trend model can retain a material advantage, pass local packaging and exact reconstruction, and become deployment-ready after remote Kaggle parity.
payload.evidence_for: E004 geometry-plus-prefix reaches 15.4913 RMSE, improves all five maps, retains 0.3331 gain under spatial blocks, and now produces byte-identical local-direct, local-notebook, and private Kaggle outputs at SHA 62ae06575baa647a5e09686bc9369cbc7303ac391e5c028468593dd6b58d5279.
payload.evidence_against: The six surface columns driving E003 are absent from test and the deployable gain shrinks to only 0.4185 RMSE, so deployment readiness does not imply standalone submission value.
payload.next_test: Use E004 as a deterministic fallback/candidate-bank leg while E005 tests explicit test-available GR/typewell PF and trellis paths.
